brand.name: Salon
brand.tagline: A private Berlin marketplace for venues and small-format entertainers.

home.headline: Curated bookings for Berlin nights
home.body: Salon connects approved venues and entertainers through one auditable booking flow. Public visitors can apply for access; private discovery stays members-only.

apply.title: Request marketplace access
apply.body: Tell us who you are and how you work in Berlin. Platform staff review every application before private marketplace access is granted.
apply.termsLabel: I acknowledge the terms and privacy notice
apply.success: Application received. You can sign in to check review status.
apply.signedOutHint: Sign in first so we can attach the application to your account.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: Authentication proves email ownership. Marketplace approval is a separate staff decision.
signIn.devNotice: Development login is enabled for this non-production environment and can never run in production.
signIn.unconfigured: No Auth.js providers are configured yet. Set OAuth credentials or AUTH_DEV_LOGIN=true for local development.

onboarding.title: Onboarding status
onboarding.noAccount: No marketplace application is linked to this account yet.

marketplace.title: Private marketplace
marketplace.body: Approved members will discover venues, entertainers, and opportunities here.
marketplace.denied: Private marketplace access requires an approved account.

admin.title: Staff review
admin.body: Change account approval states with a recorded reason.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Salon stores member profile and booking data to operate a private marketplace. Contact details stay hidden until shortlist or accepted direct request. Retention, export, and deletion procedures will be finalized with counsel before pilot.

terms.title: Terms
terms.body: Salon is a coordination marketplace, not a payment custodian or law firm. Booking agreements will use German controlling text with an English convenience translation. Live legal templates require counsel approval before production use.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for that action.
errors.validation: Please check the form and try again.
errors.invalid_transition: That approval change is not allowed.
